description: Source code for the 'explain' package in Kubernetes kubectl, providing functions for parsing JSONPath expressions, resource request parsing, and schema description printing.

methods.name: jsonPathParse
methods.description: Parses a JSONPath string into a list of nodes, removing trailing periods and handling parsing errors.

methods.name: SplitAndParseResourceRequest
methods.description: Parses a user input string into a GroupVersionResource and a list of fields, using a RESTMapper.

methods.name: SplitAndParseResourceRequestWithMatchingPrefix
methods.description: Parses a resource string into a GVR and fields, matching resource prefixes with available resources.

methods.name: PrintModelDescription
methods.description: Prints the description of a schema or specific field path, optionally recursively.
